correctness.rationale: The published XLindley density separates exactly into positive Gamma(1,rate theta) and Gamma(2,rate theta) components with weights summing to one. Convolution of two such independent latent mixtures gives Gamma shapes 2, 3, and 4 with binomial weights. Direct Poisson-gamma integration gives the stated negative-binomial PMFs. Conditional Poisson additivity proves the two-fold PXL convolution identity. The symbolic checker independently expands the resulting PMF and PGF and matches the 2026 source formulas exactly.

originality.rationale: The 2026 primary source was inspected in full at the construction, PMF, and generating-function sections. It defines the continuous two-sum convolution and the mixed-Poisson law, but does not state the three-gamma latent representation, the resulting three-negative-binomial mixture, or the equality in distribution with a sum of two PXL counts. The 2022 PXL full text likewise does not state the later convolution identity. Five focused semantic searches using model names, exact DOI, gamma-mixture, negative-binomial-mixture, and convolution aliases found no covering model-specific statement.
residual_risks: The gamma-convolution and Poisson-gamma identities are classical, so a general mixed-Poisson reference may make the model-specific decomposition an immediate corollary without naming PTS-XL.
An unindexed note may already have observed that the 2026 PGF is the square of the PXL PGF.
The structural representation is elementary once the latent gamma decomposition is recognized; its originality is model-specific rather than a new general theorem.

value.rationale: The finding converts a polynomial-exponential continuous mixer and a high-degree count PMF into a three-state latent negative-binomial model. It gives an exact sampler, a direct probabilistic interpretation of the squared PGF, and a precise bridge to the already studied PXL distribution. Because the new source motivates PTS-XL through a convolution-based construction, identifying the exact discrete convolution and finite latent mixture is a natural structural property, not an arbitrary reparameterization.
